title: Recursion
summary: Recursion solves a problem by solving smaller copies of it.

key_concepts.explanation: The input where the function stops calling itself.
The memory that tracks active function calls.

outline.heading: Writing recursive functions
points: Always define the base case first.
Each call must move toward the base case.

outline.heading: Costs
points: Deep recursion can overflow the stack.

assignments.task: Write a recursive Fibonacci with memoisation

questions: What is the time complexity of naive Fibonacci?
